name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 5 visits over 33 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 33 hours starting 2026-05-20, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.59 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
